messages:
nora: quick postmortem follow-up from the 05/02 tail-latency incident. proposing two small but important changes: (1) a playbook merge-gate that requires the 'pattern-match' checkbox + sample outputs in PRs, (2) a weekly monitor job that surfaces repeat patterns to the Pattern Board.

maggie: short and practical. merge-gate idea = nice, avoids half-baked runbook edits.

devon: for the merge-gate we should require: runbook PR includes (a) copy-paste-safe triage commands, (b) sample output snippet for each command, (c) owner + verification steps. I can add a template check in CI.

anya: automation note: the CI check can assert presence of a "pattern-match" field in PM link and simple regex for sample outputs. timeline: I can deliver the CI hook in 5 days.

nora: sample triage commands (copy-paste safe):
redwoodctl cache stats --namespace=inference --prefix=kv_prefix --json
redwoodctl model get-config --model=redwood-alpha --show-fallbacks
kubectl -n inference get hpa inference-hpa -o yaml
curl -sS -w "%{time_total}" -o /dev/null https://inference.svc/healthz

maggie: also add a short playbook step that says: "If incident matches an existing pattern, tag Pattern Board and set RCA follow-up within 7d."

devon: CI merge-gate owners: devon -> adding CI check (PR in 48h), anya -> test harness (5d), nora -> update playbook template (EOD).

ops-bot: Created task INCIDENT-6120 "Playbook merge-gate + weekly pattern monitor" assigned to nora, due 2026-05-10.

maggie: thanks team. I'll post the checklist to incidents board and close. if CI owners hit blockers ping me. :white_check_mark:
